title: spec: a dataset measure can name only a fixed ISO currency, so a measure over tenant-currency amounts cannot display the tenant currency
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

**Found by** hotcrm#2569, measured on 18.5.0; re-read on objectstack main.

`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts` ~568–573: a measure's display currency is `currency: z.string().length(3)`, an ISO code only. A derived measure over sums of tenant-currency amounts (hotcrm Projects Overview `actual_cost_sum`, labor + expense) has no way to say "the tenant currency", so it renders bare; naming a code would pin one currency into a package meant for any tenant.

**Expected:** a way to declare (or a default that resolves) the tenant/home currency for a measure, as amounts on records already do.
